semanticDeltaReview.detail: Separate alternative triangles are uniformly fitted from visible points and full circle extents. Every point in each configuration, including construction supports, receives the same similarity. The changed arbitrary obtuse example has base 4 and height 1.7: apex about 99.270927 degrees remains obtuse. Right and acute alternatives remain unchanged in shape. Circumcentres and incentres retain their asserted incidence and distances.

Independent acute and obtuse examples have base 4 and heights 8 and 1.4: apex angles about 28.072487 and 110.015960 degrees preserve their classes. The equilateral example remains equilateral. Both centres stay on the symmetry axis; both circles remain. In the coincident-centre case the shared point is labelled O and an explicit visible note states that O and E coincide. Taller bounds and offsets preserve the construction.

All relative source-grid positions are preserved by a single uniform similarity for each card; only viewport size/fitting and H label offset change. Reflections A to M and B to C, equal halves and perpendicularity remain exact.
